Maximum capacity (Emax) 500 kg up to and including 2500 kg 3000 kg up to and including 15000 kg
Minimum dead load 0 kg 0 kg
Accuracy Class C C
Rated Output 3,0 mV/V 2,0 ± 0,2 mV/V

Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval Y = Emax / vmin 15000 8500
Ratio of minimum dead load output return Z = Emax / (2 * DR) 4000 25000
Input impedance 400 Ω ± 50 Ω
Temperature range - 10 °C / + 40 °C
Fraction pLC 0,7
Humidity Class CH

Each produced load cell is provided with an accompanying document with information about its characteristics. The above identified Type (represented by the sample(s) identified in the OIML Test Report) have been found to comply with the additional national requirements established by the United States of America (NIST Handbook 44 and NCWM Publication 14), included in the MAA Declaration of Mutual Confidence: - R 60 DoMC-01 rev.0, Additional requirements from the United States; - R 60 DoMC-02 rev.0, Additional requirements from the United States. 101
